ship.nav.label: Shipping sections
ship.kind.hint.address: A courier brings the order to the address the shopper enters.
ship.kind.hint.pickup_point: The shopper picks a branch or parcel locker of the carrier. Needs a carrier that offers pickup points.
ship.kind.hint.store_pickup: The shopper collects the order at your store. The description below is shown to the shopper.
ship.list.intro: Delivery methods the shopper chooses at checkout. While no method is active, the checkout has no delivery step and works as before.
ship.list.caption: Delivery methods
ship.list.emptyBody: Create a method and activate it to offer delivery at checkout. Until then the checkout asks for an address only.
ship.pricing.summary.carrier_on_delivery: Paid to the carrier on delivery
ship.form.codeHintCreate: Lowercase letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter (for example courier). It cannot be changed later.
ship.form.title: Title
ship.form.descriptionHint: Optional. A short note about the method.
ship.form.descriptionHintPickup: Shown to the shopper: where and when to collect the order.
ship.form.providerCodeHint: The code of an enabled carrier (see Carriers). Leave it empty for a method the shop delivers itself.
ship.form.providerCodeHintRequired: Required for a pickup point: the code of an enabled carrier that offers pickup points (see Carriers).
ship.form.providerServiceHint: Optional. The carrier's own name of a service, if it has several. Needs a carrier code.
ship.form.noCarrierForPickup: A store pickup uses no carrier.
ship.form.countriesHint: Two-letter country codes (ISO 3166-1) separated by commas or spaces, for example UA, PL. The method is offered for these destinations only.
ship.form.positionHint: The order in the list at checkout, smaller first. Leave it empty to let the server choose.
ship.form.activeHint: A new method starts inactive. While at least one method is active, every checkout with goods must choose a delivery method, so activate only when your storefront supports it (the storefront of this template does).
ship.pricing.type.free_over: Flat, free above a cart total
ship.pricing.type.carrier_on_delivery: Paid to the carrier on delivery
ship.pricing.explain.flat: Every order pays the same amount.
ship.pricing.explain.free_over: Orders pay the price, unless the cart total reaches the free-delivery threshold.
ship.pricing.explain.tiers: The price depends on the cart total. The first tier starts at 0; each next tier starts at a higher total.
ship.pricing.explain.carrier_on_delivery: The shop charges nothing; the recipient pays the carrier on delivery. The storefront shows the carrier's price as an estimate only.
ship.pricing.amountHint: Type the amount in {currency} with a dot, at most {decimals} digits after it (for example 80.50).
ship.pricing.freeFromHint: Orders whose cart total is at least this amount are delivered free.
ship.pricing.tierFromHint: The tier applies from this total. The first tier must start at 0.
ship.pricing.tierAmountHint: What the shop charges in this tier (0 for free).
ship.pricing.otherCurrency: This method is priced in {currency}, but the shop currency is now {shop}. Type the amounts again in {shop}; saving prices the method in {shop}.
ship.money.comma_separator: Use a dot, not a comma, as the decimal separator.
ship.money.inner_space: Remove the spaces inside the number.
ship.money.invalid_format: Enter a number such as 80 or 80.50.
ship.money.too_many_decimals: At most {decimals} digits after the dot.
ship.money.negative_amount: The amount must not be negative.
ship.reason.unknown_type: Choose one of the price types.
ship.reason.out_of_range: The amount is out of range.
ship.reason.too_many_tiers: There are too many tiers (at most 20).
ship.reason.first_tier_not_zero: The first tier must start at 0.
ship.reason.tiers_not_sorted: Each tier must start at a higher total than the one before.
ship.reason.duplicate_tier: Two tiers start at the same total.
ship.reason.not_an_array: The tiers must be a list.
ship.reason.not_an_object: This must be a JSON object (in curly brackets).
ship.reason.provider_required: Enter a carrier code: a pickup point, or a carrier service, needs a carrier.
ship.reason.provider_not_enabled: This carrier is not enabled in this shop. Check the code (see Carriers).
ship.reason.provider_lacks_pickup_points: This carrier does not offer pickup points.
ship.reason.invalid_key: A key may contain letters, digits and underscores and must start with a letter.
ship.reason.secret_not_allowed: This key names a credential (API key, token, password, secret). Credentials are never saved here: set them as environment variables of the server.
ship.reason.too_deep: Objects are nested too deeply (at most 4 levels).
ship.reason.too_many_keys: An object has too many keys (at most 50).
ship.reason.too_many_items: A list has too many items (at most 100).
ship.reason.unsafe_text: This text contains characters that are not allowed.
ship.reason.too_large: The profile is too large (at most 16 KiB).
ship.error.codeFormat: Use lowercase letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter (at most 64 characters).
ship.error.codeTaken: Another delivery method already has this code.
ship.error.countryFormat: “{code}” is not a two-letter country code.
ship.error.position: Enter a whole number from 0 to 1,000,000, or leave it empty.
ship.delete.title: Delete the method {code}?
ship.delete.body: The method is removed for good. If an order used it, the server refuses; deactivate the method instead.
ship.delete.info: Delete this method for good. A method that an order used cannot be deleted: deactivate it instead (shoppers no longer see it).
ship.refusal.method_in_use: Orders were placed with this method, so it cannot be deleted. Deactivate it instead: shoppers no longer see it, and the orders keep their delivery data.
ship.providers.credentialsTitle: API keys are not entered here
ship.providers.credentialsBody: A carrier's API key, and every other credential, is an environment variable of the server, set by your developers. It is never shown or saved on this page. Use “Test connection” to check that the server's key works.
ship.providers.noneTitle: No method names a carrier yet
ship.providers.noneBody: Name a carrier in a delivery method, or open a carrier by its code below.
ship.providers.partial: Only the first 100 methods were read, so this list may be incomplete. Open a carrier by its code below.
ship.providers.openTitle: Open a carrier by its code
ship.providers.codeHint: One of the codes your developers enabled on the server (the setting SHIPPING_PROVIDERS_ENABLED).
ship.providers.openDisabled: Enter a valid carrier code to open it
ship.provider.title: Carrier {code}
ship.provider.notEnabledBody: This shop does not run a carrier with this code. Check the code, or ask your developers to enable the carrier (the server setting SHIPPING_PROVIDERS_ENABLED) and restart the server.
ship.settings.title: Carrier profile
ship.settings.intro: Non-secret data the carrier needs, such as the sender's name, phone and address and a default parcel. Enter it as a JSON object. Which fields are needed depends on the carrier; ask your developers.
ship.settings.label: Profile (JSON)
ship.settings.hint: A JSON object of at most {max} KiB, nested at most 4 levels. Credentials are refused.
ship.settings.invalidJson: This is not valid JSON. Check the braces, quotes and commas.
ship.settings.moreIssues: Only the first {max} problems are listed.
ship.settings.unknownBody: The server did not answer, so the profile may or may not have been saved. Reload the page to see what is stored before you save again.
ship.check.title: Connection
ship.check.intro: Asks the carrier whether the server's credentials work. Nothing is changed.
ship.check.reason.unavailable: The carrier could not be reached or did not answer in time. Try again in a moment.
ship.check.reason.rejected: The carrier refused the request. Check the carrier's settings and the profile.
ship.check.reason.invalid_credentials: The carrier does not accept the server's credentials. Ask your developers to check the API key (an environment variable of the server).
ship.check.reason.not_supported: This carrier does not support the connection check.
ship.check.unknownBody: The server did not answer. The check changes nothing, so you can run it again.
